key_insight: HexFormer embeds visual features in hyperbolic space and integrates exponential-map-based aggregation into the transformer attention, enabling the model to more naturally represent hierarchical and relational structure in images.
problem_solved: Standard Euclidean Vision Transformers struggle to compactly represent hierarchical/relational structure present in many image modalities; this work addresses that limitation by moving attention and feature aggregation into hyperbolic geometry.
method: Represent image tokens and features on a hyperbolic manifold to capture tree-like and hierarchical relations more naturally than Euclidean embeddings.
Introduce exponential map aggregation inside the attention mechanism so key/value combination and updates occur on the manifold (preserving geometric consistency).
Explore two architectural variants (including a hyperbolic ViT called HexFormer) and evaluate their behavior for image classification to compare manifold-aware designs.
impact: Brings geometric inductive bias for hierarchies into transformer-based vision models, offering practitioners a principled way to improve representation fidelity for hierarchical/relational data and potentially yield more compact or semantically structured embeddings.
visual_elements: Side-by-side visualization of a hierarchical tree embedded in Euclidean space vs hyperbolic space (showing better separation/compactness in hyperbolic space).
Schematic of HexFormer attention block highlighting exponential map aggregation from tangent space to manifold during key/value aggregation.
Performance mini-chart comparing HexFormer variants to a baseline ViT on image classification (accuracy vs model type) as a conceptual example.
Illustration of the exponential map operation: tangent vector → mapped point on hyperbolic manifold (simple 2D manifold depiction).
paper_title: HexFormer: Hyperbolic Vision Transformer with Exponential Map Aggregation
paper_authors: Haya Alyoussef, Ahmad Bdeir, Diego Coello de Portugal Mecke, Tom Hanika, Niels Landwehr
